title: Rabbi Chalafta of Kefar Chananyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Avot 3:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Pirkei_Avot.3.6), where he said: “Ten who sit and occupy themselves with Torah, the Divine Presence rests among them … and from where [do we know] that even one,” etc.

Hyman identifies him as a student of Rabbi Meir, as in [Bava Metzia 94a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.94a.7): “It was taught: Abba Chalafta of Kefar Chananya says in the name of Rabbi Meir.” In [Tosefta Kelim Kamma 4:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Kelim_Kamma.4.9): “Rabbi Chalafta of Kefar Chananyah said: I asked Shimon ben Chananyah, who asked the son of Rabbi Chanina ben Teradyon,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Avot Hebrew calls him Chalafta ben Dosa. In Bava Metzia he speaks in Rabbi Meir’s name, the basis of Hyman’s statement about discipleship. The linked Tosefta gives the chain through Shimon ben Chananyah to the son of Rabbi Chanina ben Teradyon. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1325&lang=en) records both chains.
